fork.name: openpilot
fork.description: The upstream commaai/openpilot itself — the reference ADAS operating system that all community forks derive from. Provides camera-based lane centering, adaptive cruise, end-to-end Experimental Mode, and driver monitoring on 334 officially supported cars, with additional dashcam-only, custom (SecOC), and community-known ports in the code.

features.name: Automated Lane Centering
features.description: Continuously steers to keep the car centered in its lane whenever engaged. Works down to 0 mph on most cars; some models have a minimum steering speed or below-standard steering torque (noted per car).

features.name: openpilot Longitudinal Control
features.description: openpilot controls gas and brake instead of the car's stock adaptive cruise. Standard on some cars; on many others it is 'openpilot Longitudinal Control (Alpha)', a Developer-panel toggle (AlphaLongitudinalEnabled) only available on non-release branches; on 'Stock ACC' cars openpilot only steers.

features.name: Experimental Mode (end-to-end longitudinal)
features.description: The driving model directly decides speed: slows for turns, stops for traffic lights and stop signs, and drives more naturally. Opt-in toggle; requires openpilot longitudinal control, so it is unavailable on stock-ACC cars and alpha-gated where longitudinal is alpha.

features.name: Driver Monitoring
features.description: Infrared interior camera tracks head pose and eyes, warning and eventually disengaging if the driver is distracted or drowsy. Works day and night on all cars.

features.name: Stop and Go
features.description: Follows traffic to a complete stop and resumes automatically. Some cars cannot accelerate below a threshold speed or cannot resume from a standstill without a button press (noted per car from the CARS.md columns).

features.name: Lane Change Assist
features.description: Driver-initiated lane changes: signal and nudge the wheel, and openpilot completes the lane change. Stock behavior always requires the torque nudge (no nudgeless option).

features.name: Full-Speed-Range Steering
features.description: Whether lane centering works from 0 mph. Cars with a firmware minimum steering speed ('No ALC below X mph' in CARS.md) only steer above that speed.

features.name: Driving Personality
features.description: Aggressive / Standard / Relaxed follow-distance and accel behavior, selectable in settings and, on supported cars, via the steering-wheel distance button (LongitudinalPersonality param).

features.name: Lane Departure Warnings
features.description: Alerts when drifting over a lane line above 31 mph without a turn signal, even when openpilot is not engaged. Toggle (IsLdwEnabled).

features.name: Always-On Driver Monitoring
features.description: Optional toggle (AlwaysOnDM) that keeps driver monitoring active even when openpilot is disengaged.

features.name: Disengage on Accelerator toggle
features.description: Configurable whether pressing the gas pedal disengages openpilot (DisengageOnAccelerator). Disabling it lets openpilot stay engaged while you press the accelerator — the stock counterpart to forks' 'no disengage' options.

features.name: Record & Upload Driver Camera
features.description: Opt-in upload of the driver-facing camera to improve the driver monitoring model (RecordFront).

features.name: Record & Upload Microphone Audio
features.description: Opt-in microphone recording included in the dashcam video in comma connect (RecordAudio).

features.name: Firehose Mode
features.description: Dedicated settings page to maximize training-data upload to comma while on WiFi; device-level, car-independent.

features.name: comma connect / athena + OTA updates
features.description: Cloud pairing via the athena service: drive review in comma connect, remote SSH tunneling, prime navigation data, and over-the-air software updates (updated/updaterd). Device-level, car-independent.

features.name: SecOC (TRON) car support
features.description: Support for Toyota SecOC-authenticated platforms (RAV4 Prime, Sienna 2021+, non-US Yaris) using a user-provided SecOCKey param. Classified 'Custom' support: dashcam-only on release branches; not plug-and-play.
